description.narrative: This Action aims to fund:A Cooperation Facility for Bangladesh for the period 2025-2029, providing the EU with the possibility to finance small-scale activities that are needed for the achievement of the objectives of the Neighbourhood, Development and International Cooperation Instrument (NDICI-Global Europe), as articulated in the country¿s MIP 2021-2027 and the priority areas defined there. The Cooperation Facility will also provide necessary targeted support to sectors that have been identified by the Government of Bangladesh as priorities for reforms, in line with the Government¿s requests for support in designing and implementing those reforms. The reform priority sectors include public administration, anti-corruption, judiciary, electoral system, public security, and the financial sector. The Cooperation Facility will also support civil society organisations including social partners, NGOs, grassroots organisations, think-tanks, research centres and academia that contribute to the implementation of reforms by bringing civil society perspectives, needs and concerns.The Action aims to support programming and delivery of interventions across all three MIP priority areas. While complementing EU initiatives to design and implement interventions that are relevant to the ongoing and emerging reforms in Bangladesh in line with the country MIP 2021-2027, the Action will also support the ongoing Team Europe Initiatives in the areas of green energy transition and decent work with tailored activities. The support will also contribute to the implementation of the EU Gender Action Plan (GAP III) at country level through gender mainstreaming in programming, policy dialogue and strategic communication with state and non-state actors.
